purpose: shared deterministic golden fixture for S1/S2/S3/S4/S6

array_semantics.sequence_ids: four contiguous blocks of 16 tokens using exact ids 0,1,2,3; every id appears
array_semantics.positions: zero-based contiguous 0..15 inside each sequence; restart at sequence boundary; no interleaving
array_semantics.state_signatures: shape [T,L,D] exactly matches array_shapes and all values are finite
array_semantics.expert_ids: shape [T,L,K] exactly matches array_shapes and all ids satisfy 0 <= id < router.num_experts
array_semantics.expert_weights: shape [T,L,K] exactly matches array_shapes; finite, nonnegative, and each [token,layer,:] sum is within tolerance of 1

producer: S0 fixture generator or frozen committed small artifact
note: This specification freezes semantics. Binary safetensors payload is added only with deterministic generator, exact derived shape/stat metadata, and recorded SHA-256.
